limitations: Synthetic frame edits created by fixed independent script on REAL approved owner video; NOT independent external human-labeled natural defects
Frames from same video are highly correlated; 9 positives and 621 negatives cannot be interpreted as 630 independent production videos or real-world error-rate confidence intervals
Source-bound PSNR checks a predefined ordered frame sequence tolerance, not subjective motion correctness or video quality across unknown edits
No-reference early low-motion rule intentionally exempted author-approved camera hold by source policy. Without that policy the final hold creates false alerts
Even deliberately altered film reaches HTML5 ended; playback success and normal PTS cannot certify user-perceived correctness
Original film has no audio track and cannot validate AV synchronization
No live SWAAG registered tool invocation. Policy evaluation uses actual source-attested evidence offline.
No production media, 3D render, gallery, model service or previously denied retrieval modified or retried.
